ja: • 重爆撃機「ガルント」が完全新規設計でメカコレに登場。
• メカコレ「宇宙戦艦ヤマト2199」に差し込むことが可能なヤマトと同スケールの特殊削岩弾付属。
• 特殊削岩弾の色は成形色で再現。
成形品×4、組立説明書（箱裏に印刷）
en: • The heavy bomber "Garunt" is now available in the mechanical collection with a completely new design.
• A special jackhammer of the same scale as Yamato that can be inserted into the mechanical collection "Space Battleship Yamato 2199" is included.
• The color of the special jackhammer is reproduced by molding color.
Molded product x 4, assembly manual (printed on the back of the box)
